title: Wishing Well
html:
Wishing Well

The Wishing Well is at the top of Townston, near the Loremaster. Toss in King's Coins (1 if you're a member, 2 if you're not) and it hands something back. Paid tosses drop two items. The first toss is free and drops one. All of it is non-member, not soulbound, and at your current level.

Ninja and Pirate items are only available from the Wishing Well. The ninja look is unique (purple). The pirate rainbows, the mouse-ear helms, and the other Well-only rainbow names are on Well-Only Rainbows. Named boss lair rainbows can also come out of the Well once you are high enough for that dungeon.

The Well is ready every 30 minutes. If it is up it has an ! like a quest giver. If it is not, it has nothing.

Contents

  • 1 What the piles are
  • 2 Odds
  • 3 Well-specific pile
  • 4 Seasonal pile
  • 5 First toss

What the piles are

Each toss rolls several bags of names at once. This page calls those bags piles. Hitting a pile means you got something from that bag. It is not the odds for one name.

  • Shared pile — the same names every dungeon boss corpse rolls. There is a shared purple bag and a shared rainbow bag. Sissirat and Manglefeet are rolling the same rainbow names, filtered by your level. The Well also rolls those bags. You can farm those names in dungeons. Which rainbow names can show at your level is on Rainbow Level Bands.
  • Well-specific pile — the Well's extra bag. Pirate rainbows, the mouse-ear helms, Charge!, NC Hammer, named lair-chest pieces, skill books, and a gold brick. Some of those names only come from the Well. Some also come from a lair chest. The only-Well names are on Well-Only Rainbows.
  • Seasonal pile — holiday names. They only roll when that holiday look is in the mix. The rest of the year those rows are off. They are not the everyday Well list.
  • Yellow fallback — a rare (yellow) item. Always in the mix. You see this a lot because the other bags miss.

Odds

The Well does not use dungeon loot percent. Difficulty and the loot number on a monster tooltip do nothing here. These 1-in-N numbers are the same kind of roll as the boss tables on Rainbow Drops. A paid toss is two of those rolls.

WhatPer item
Yellow (rare), the leftover when nothing else hitsalways in the mix
Shared purple — uniques from the same bag bosses drop1 in 3
Well-specific pile — the Well's extra bag, not one name1 in 20
Shared rainbow — mythics from the same bag bosses drop1 in 125
Seasonal purple — holiday uniques, only when that pack is on1 in 10
Seasonal rainbow — holiday mythics, only when that pack is on1 in 200

Two items on a paid toss means two shots. About 1 in 10 to see the Well-specific pile at least once. About 1 in 63 to see a shared-pile rainbow at least once. Those are still pile hits, not one name.

Well-specific pile

1 in 20 is the extra bag, not a single name. That bag holds the pirate set, the mouse-ear helms, Charge!, NC Hammer, named lair pieces, skill books, and a gold brick. Armor is the common branch. After that it splits again. A given name is a lot rarer than 1 in 20. Rough ranges for the Well-only names are on Well-Only Rainbows.

Named lair pieces are the short lists on a boss chest — Sissirat through Manglefeet. Those names are on Boss Lair Rainbows. The Well can spit them once you are high enough for that dungeon. They are not only-Well.

Seasonal pile

Holiday names sit in their own bag. When that holiday pack is on, the Well also rolls a seasonal purple (1 in 10) and a seasonal rainbow (1 in 200). When the pack is off, those rolls are gone. Known seasonal rainbows include Love/Hate (mostly Hate), Flower Power, and Sunny Side Up Yours. Holiday hats such as Shivery's Scrapper Hat can also come out of that bag.

Those names are not on the everyday Well-only list, and they are not the shared pile you farm off bosses.

First toss

One item. The Well-specific pile on that toss is 1 in 10. The shared rainbow roll is the ordinary boss-corpse table, not the paid-Well 1 in 125: 1 in 200 below 90, 1 in 75 at 90. Gold can also hit.
